bank_sync.title: Bank Messages
bank_sync.uses_shortcuts: Works through an Apple Shortcuts automation
bank_sync.uses_sms: Needs permission to read your bank's SMS
bank_sync.intro_subtitle: Every time you pay, transfer or get paid, your bank texts you. Money Time reads that SMS and logs it for you — amount, merchant and card included.
bank_sync.how_1_desc: After every card payment, transfer or deposit.
bank_sync.how_2_desc: Amount, merchant, card and date — right on your phone.
bank_sync.how_3_desc: Add, edit or ignore it. Or let clear ones add themselves.
bank_sync.privacy_desc: Only messages from the banks you choose are read, on your device. Personal chats and OTP codes are never touched.
bank_sync.waiting_first: Waiting for your first bank message
bank_sync.auto_add_desc: Messages we read fully become transactions right away. Anything unclear still waits for you.
bank_sync.keep_one_bank: Keep at least one bank connected — or disconnect instead.
bank_sync.shortcuts_unavailable: Couldn't open Shortcuts on this device.
bank_sync.disconnect_message: New bank messages won't be read anymore. Messages you already have stay in your inbox.
bank_sync.added_to_inbox: Added to your inbox for review
bank_sync.filed_not_transaction: This message isn't a transaction — filed under Ignored
bank_sync.banks_subtitle: We'll only read SMS from the senders you pick.
bank_sync.banks_note: You can add or remove banks anytime.
bank_sync.shortcut_subtitle: iPhone doesn't let apps read SMS, so a Shortcuts automation hands each bank alert to Money Time. One-time setup, about a minute.
bank_sync.shortcut_1_desc: Leave “Sender” empty — banks' sender names can't be picked there.
bank_sync.shortcut_2_title: “Message Contains”: a word every bank alert has
bank_sync.shortcut_2_desc: Tap to copy one, paste it, then choose “Run Immediately”. Only messages from your linked banks are sent; anything else stays on your phone.
bank_sync.shortcut_3_desc: Next → New Blank Automation → Add Action → search Money Time → “Log Bank Message”. Message: tap the field → Shortcut Input. Sender: tap the field → Shortcut Input → Sender. No Sender option? Pick your bank in “Bank” and use a word only that bank sends.
bank_sync.shortcut_4_title: Done — repeat for the other words
bank_sync.shortcut_4_desc: From now on every alert from your banks lands in your inbox in about a second. Offline? It's kept and sent when you open Money Time.
bank_sync.sms_subtitle: Money Time reads alerts from your {count} selected banks — nothing else.
bank_sync.sms_reads_1: SMS from the banks you selected
bank_sync.sms_reads_2: The amount, merchant, card and date in them
bank_sync.scan_history_desc: Bring in recent alerts so your month starts complete.
bank_sync.mode_subtitle: Pick what happens when a new bank message arrives.
bank_sync.mode_review_desc: New messages wait in your inbox until you confirm them.
bank_sync.mode_auto_desc: Clear messages become transactions instantly. Unclear ones still wait for review.
bank_sync.mode_note: You can change this anytime from Bank Messages.

bank_sync.done_waiting: New bank messages will show up in your inbox as they arrive.
bank_sync.not_connected_desc: Connect your bank to review its SMS alerts here.
bank_sync.empty_review_desc: New bank messages will show up here.
bank_sync.empty_added_desc: Messages you add become transactions and are listed here.
bank_sync.empty_ignored_desc: Messages you skip — and OTPs or offers — end up here.
bank_sync.ignored_footer: OTP codes and offers are filed here automatically.
bank_sync.banner_subtitle: Add them to your transactions in a tap
bank_sync.not_transaction_desc: This looks like a code or an offer, so it wasn't turned into a transaction.
bank_sync.check_type_desc: The message doesn't say — pick the right type below.
bank_sync.check_amount_desc: No currency was written next to it. Tap Amount to fix it if needed.
bank_sync.merchant_hint: Where the money went or came from
bank_sync.tap_to_edit: Tap any row to change it before adding.
bank_sync.not_a_transaction: We couldn't find a transaction in this message.
bank_sync.paste_subtitle: Paste an SMS from your bank — we'll read it for you.
bank_sync.paste_hint: e.g. Your card ending 4821 was charged EGP 245.50 at …
bank_sync.already_have: You already have this message in your inbox
bank_sync.other_phone_iphone: New bank messages are logged by the Shortcuts automation on your iPhone. You can still review them here.
bank_sync.other_phone_android: New bank messages are read on your Android phone. You can still review them here.
bank_sync.scan_failed: Connected — but recent messages couldn't be imported. New ones will still arrive.
bank_sync.scanning: Importing your last 30 days of bank messages…
bank_sync.sms_denied_desc: Money Time can't read new bank messages without it. You can still connect and paste messages yourself, or allow access later from settings.
bank_sync.sms_off_title: SMS access is off on this phone
bank_sync.sms_off_desc: New bank messages won't be captured here until you allow it. Pasting still works.
bank_sync.changed_elsewhere: This message was already changed elsewhere
bank_sync.capture_revoked_desc: Another phone took over bank messages, or your password changed. New alerts are not read here until you switch it back.
bank_sync.capture_moved: This phone now captures your bank messages
